name: dpkg
summary: Manages .deb packages at a low level.
description: The tool apt is built on. dpkg installs a local .deb file, but downloads nothing and does not resolve dependencies; if dependencies are missing, sudo apt install -f fills them in. Today, sudo apt install ./file.deb does it all at once. dpkg is still very useful for querying the list of installed packages.
